original.statement: The CRD bundle diff between v0.15.0 and v0.16.0 shows that the ClusterSecretStore CRD now serves a new API version, external-secrets.io/v1.

decision.reason: The render shows that external-secrets.io/v1 ClusterSecretStore did not exist in 0.15.0 and is served in 0.16.0 [ev-4bda269d1e81][ev-bde2792c197a][ev-acf4ed4bcd3b]. Adding a version takes nothing away, so the only environments it is relevant to are those that already use ClusterSecretStore under any version. The proposed condition, gvk-in-use for group external-secrets.io and kind ClusterSecretStore with no version pinned, expresses exactly that scope. The same bundle also removes v1alpha1, drops the conversion webhook and moves storage away from v1beta1 [ev-f978a29a8906][ev-4cac666b69f8][ev-d55f4ac0a53f], but those are separate changes and should not widen or narrow this item's condition.
